question: Which rites are to be performed after the ritual release of the parents?
premises: The release of the parents is performed as a ritual act.
Tonsure and initiation are included among the following rites.
Additional rites are indicated by the suffix meaning and so on.
inference: After releasing the parents, one should perform the tonsure, initiation, and related rites.
plain_english: Having performed the release of the parents, one should carry out the tonsure, initiation, and other such rites.
